lines.words: sagala jolma arahonku, mamuji Naibata tongtong.

lines.text: Talup do gok ni uhurhin, hubaen pasangap Tuhan in.
lines.words: Talup do gok ni uhurhin, hubaen pasangap Tuhan in.

lines.text: Ulang ma modom ho tonduyhu, sai puho ho, sai hehe ma.
lines.words: Ulang ma modom ho tonduyhu, sai puho ho, sai hehe ma.

lines.text: Pongkut ma ho bani horjamu, sai puji Tuhan Naibata.
lines.words: Pongkut ma ho bani horjamu, sai puji Tuhan Naibata.

lines.text: Sai baen ma gok ni pandeimin, laho mamuji Tuhan in.
lines.words: Sai baen ma gok ni pandeimin, laho mamuji Tuhan in.

lines.text: Tarima kasih ma uhurhu, Bamu o Naibata tongtong.
lines.words: Tarima kasih ma uhurhu, Bamu o Naibata tongtong.

lines.text: Ibahen dearni layak-Mu, binere-Mu hubangku on.
lines.words: Ibahen dearni layak-Mu, binere-Mu hubangku on.

lines.text: Ai ipatudu Ham tongtong ganup na porlu bangku on.
lines.words: Ai ipatudu Ham tongtong ganup na porlu bangku on.

lines.text: Hupuji pakon Ham, o Jesus, ibaen parholong ateiMu.
lines.words: Hupuji pakon Ham, o Jesus, ibaen parholong ateiMu.

lines.text: Mardingat darohMu madurus, pakon ganupan layak-Mu.
lines.words: Mardingat darohMu madurus, pakon ganupan layak-Mu.

lines.text: Mambahen haluahon on, hubai pardousa banggal on.
lines.words: Mambahen haluahon on, hubai pardousa banggal on.

lines.text: Ham pe homa, Tonduy Napansing, sai jalo Ham ma dodingkon.
lines.words: Ham pe homa, Tonduy Napansing, sai jalo Ham ma dodingkon.

lines.text: Margogoh anjaha matunggung do Ham, mangapoh uhurhon
lines.words: Margogoh anjaha matunggung do Ham, mangapoh uhurhon

lines.text: Ia hubaen na dear in, halani gogoh-Mu do in.
lines.words: Ia hubaen na dear in, halani gogoh-Mu do in.

lines.text: Ai ise do mamasu-masu, au on o Naibata, lang Ham?
lines.words: Ai ise do mamasu-masu, au on o Naibata, lang Ham?

lines.text: Pamatang rap pakon tonduyhu, sai iparmudu-mudu Ham
lines.words: Pamatang rap pakon tonduyhu, sai iparmudu-mudu Ham

lines.text: Jaha lumbang uhur-Mu in mangidah pardousaonkin.
lines.words: Jaha lumbang uhur-Mu in mangidah pardousaonkin.

lines.text: Sai layakMu do pujionku sadokah na manggoluh au.
lines.words: Sai layakMu do pujionku sadokah na manggoluh au.

lines.text: Sai Goran-Mu pasangaponku sadokah na marhosah au
lines.words: Sai Goran-Mu pasangaponku sadokah na marhosah au

lines.text: Ronsi rotap ni hosahkin, sai pujionku Ham ijin.
lines.words: Ronsi rotap ni hosahkin, sai pujionku Ham ijin.

lines.text: Sai jalo ma, ale Tuhanku, pamujingkon na hurang in.
lines.words: Sai jalo ma, ale Tuhanku, pamujingkon na hurang in.

lines.text: Paima das au on hu surga, ianan na gok dear in,
lines.words: Paima das au on hu surga, ianan na gok dear in,

lines.text: Marlaksa hali ma ijin, dodingkononku Tuhankin.
lines.words: Marlaksa hali ma ijin, dodingkononku Tuhankin.
